title: Drop Punt The Truest Kick (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the drop punt is the truest kick
End over end backwards spin
Flies straight, lands flat, every time

[Verse 1]
Hold the ball with two hands at chest height
Laces facing up, point the nose down right
Guide hand on the side, kick foot ready below
Drop the ball straight down onto the boot toe

[Pre-Chorus]
Kick foot swings through, locked at the knee
Contact the bottom third of the ball with glee
The ball spins backwards, end over end
Spiral free flight, never bend

[Chorus]
Drop punt the truest kick, son
End over end backward spin, the work begun
Laces up, point the nose down
Foot through the bottom third, win the crown

[Verse 2]
Follow through high, kicking foot to the chest
Non kicking arm balances out the rest
Forty metres easy, fifty metres with effort
The drop punt is the bread and butter, never desert

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the drop punt is the foundation
Learn it first, master it, then variation
Torpedo punt for distance, banana for the curve
But the drop punt is the kick to serve

[Chorus]
Drop punt the truest kick, son
End over end backward spin, the work begun
Laces up, point the nose down
Foot through the bottom third, win the crown

[Outro]
Laces up, nose down
Foot through the bottom
End over end straight
Thats my boy, kick straight
